metadata.description: Personal, portable toolkit of reusable Claude systems: skills, rules, hooks, and templates shared across every project and device.

plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: Two skills: project-init offers the Git-native work-tracker and complete second-brain v3 during new-project setup; project-sync audits existing projects and safely adopts approved toolkit systems.

plugins.name: sf-architect-solutioning
plugins.description: Salesforce solution architect skill: pushes back on vague requirements, verifies platform facts against official Salesforce docs (live fetch, never memory), designs declarative-first to Well-Architected standards, and produces an approved solution plan before any build.

plugins.name: second-brain
plugins.description: Git-native Markdown memory and knowledge for Claude and Codex, with shared schemas, owner-approved updates, and an on-demand memory librarian.

plugins.name: git-workflows
plugins.description: Three parallel-session-safe git lifecycle skills. pull-latest updates without rewriting history, reset-to-remote mirrors a remote behind explicit confirmation, and merge-and-clean-up lands an approved pull request before safely removing only its branch and worktree.

plugins.name: hooks-library
plugins.description: Guard hooks that enforce the checkable toolkit rules mechanically instead of restating them. writing-guard is a Stop hook that catches em dashes, section signs, and filler openers in the final reply and sends it back to be rewritten before the owner sees it.

plugins.name: session-autoname
plugins.description: Keeps a background Claude Code agent session named after the single overarching PROJECT it is working toward, not the step it happens to be on. A Stop hook runs at the end of every turn and asks Haiku for a short project-level label, judged from the arc of the owner's own requests (never the assistant's replies, which narrate the current step) and anchored by feeding the current name back in so it is returned unchanged unless the project genuinely changed. Keeps the job list accurate as a long session drifts off the task it started on, without the name churning every few minutes. Background sessions only, never blocks a turn, and fails silently if Claude Code's internal state format changes.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Relentless discovery interview skill that asks one question at a time, recommends a likely answer, and checkpoints every response to a durable brainstorm file before continuing.

plugins.name: work-tracker
plugins.description: Git-native work tracking shared by Claude and Codex, with deterministic status, handoffs, relationships, Git landing verification, generated dashboards, and optional GitHub Issues and Projects synchronization.
